title: Creating Predictable Home Rhythms
learningGoal: Establish predictable rhythms that support emotional safety for children.
microLesson: Predictable rhythms reduce anxiety and help children feel secure. These include wake-up routines, meal patterns, and consistent evening flow.
activity: Create a simple daily rhythm with 3–5 anchor points.

title: Supporting Emotional Expression
learningGoal: Help children express emotions safely and confidently.
microLesson: Children need language and modelling to express emotions. Naming feelings reduces overwhelm and builds emotional literacy.
activity: Practice a feelings‑naming exercise with your child.

title: Reducing Conflict in the Home
learningGoal: Identify conflict triggers and reduce escalation risks.
microLesson: Conflict often arises from stress, unmet needs, or unclear expectations. Reducing triggers increases safety and stability.
activity: Identify two conflict triggers and create a prevention plan.

title: Strengthening Positive Behaviour
learningGoal: Use positive reinforcement to support healthy behaviour.
microLesson: Children respond best to positive reinforcement—praise, attention, and predictable rewards—rather than punishment.

title: Building Safe Communication Habits
learningGoal: Develop communication habits that reduce tension and increase connection.
microLesson: Safe communication uses calm tone, clear expectations, and non‑threatening language. It models emotional safety for children.
activity: Rewrite a recent conversation using safe‑communication principles.

title: Creating a Calming Home Environment
learningGoal: Reduce sensory and emotional stressors in the home.
microLesson: Noise, clutter, unpredictable routines, and tension increase stress. Small environmental changes improve emotional safety.
activity: Identify one environmental stressor and create a reduction plan.

title: Weekly Reflection and Stability Review
learningGoal: Reflect on progress and identify areas needing support.
microLesson: Weekly reflection helps track emotional safety, routines, communication, and parenting progress.
activity: Write a 150‑word reflection on improvements and challenges.
